official_sources: Open space, sports and recreation facilities guidance

official_measurement_examples.name: Statutory consultee status
official_measurement_examples.fact: Sport England has statutory-consultee status for relevant planning applications affecting playing fields.

official_measurement_examples.name: 2025-26 performance
official_measurement_examples.fact: Sport England reports almost 99% of statutory consultation requests received a substantive response within 21 days or another agreed date in 2025-26.

official_measurement_examples.name: Consultation is not decision
official_measurement_examples.fact: Sport England's response informs the LPA decision; it is not itself the grant or refusal of planning permission.

official_measurement_examples.name: Playing-field definition scope
official_measurement_examples.fact: Whether land falls within the statutory playing-field consultation scope requires the applicable definition and facts; map appearance alone is insufficient.

official_measurement_examples.name: Policy exceptions
official_measurement_examples.fact: Playing-fields policy contains exceptions and assessment criteria; an affected playing field is not automatically equivalent to absolute development prohibition.

official_measurement_examples.name: Pre-application service status
official_measurement_examples.fact: Sport England stated on 1 July 2026 that its pre-application advice service was temporarily suspended due to capacity constraints; this does not alter statutory consultation duties.

official_measurement_examples.name: Demand tools
official_measurement_examples.fact: Facilities calculators and Active Places tools support planning evidence but do not determine planning permission or site ownership.

official_measurement_examples.name: Parcel limitation
official_measurement_examples.fact: Sport England consultation status does not establish title, replacement feasibility or final development yield.

core_rules: Sport England consultation is not planning permission
Sport England objection is not itself final refusal
no objection is not automatic approval
pre-application service status is not statutory duty status
sports demand tools are not permission decisions
playing-field data does not establish ownership
consultation performance metric is not parcel outcome
open space and playing field are not always identical categories
planning decision-maker remains LPA or SoS as applicable
consultation response date must retain context
no parcel playing-field clearance or Future Growth score may be promoted while recovery is parked
source_verification_note: Sport England and GOV.UK sources checked 2026-07-26; 2025-26 statutory-consultee performance and 1 July 2026 pre-application service status retained.
